confirmed-by-the-owner-on: The player signed in with Wargaming.net ID on {date}, so this prices the vehicles actually in their garage: the ones they have sold are left out, and the ones they own but have never driven are counted.
counts-every-vehicle-ever-driven: Nobody has signed in with this account, so this counts every vehicle it has ever taken into battle. Wargaming tells a stranger which vehicles were played, never which are still owned, so vehicles sold long ago are priced here and vehicles bought and never driven are missing.
